home.hero_title: BE EQUIPPED. BE TRANSFORMED. BE SENT.
home.hero_tagline: Discover Christ. Grow in the Word. Be Equipped to Reach Others.
home.hero_support: Complete your registration and you'll be directed straight to our official WhatsApp Community.
home.training_description: For those seeking deeper Kingdom training, wanting to be equipped to teach and reach others, growing in leadership and evangelism, or using modern media for disciple-making.
home.discover_supporting: Prayer • God's Word • Faith • Spiritual Growth
home.discover_description: Whether you are seeking God, beginning your journey with Christ, looking for prayer, or simply wanting to understand God's Word and find biblical answers for your life, you are welcome here.
home.vision_body: To leverage modern media to make the Gospel of the Kingdom accessible in every nation.
home.how_1_body: Pick Training or Discover & Grow — whichever fits where you are right now.
home.how_2_body: Share your name and WhatsApp number — it takes less than a minute.
home.how_3_body: You're directed straight to the right WhatsApp Community for your language.

welcome.title: You Are Loved, and You Are Not Alone
welcome.body: Whatever brought you here today, God sees you — and He has good news for you. Jesus Christ came so that you could know Him, be forgiven, and walk in real hope, no matter where you've been or what you're facing.

organizationalLeadershipRecommendations.description: Community Leaders may recommend a person for future leadership of a next-generation Community under their own Community. A recommendation is a recommendation only — approving one does not create a Community and does not appoint the person. To create a Community, use the Communities tab. To formally appoint a leader, use the New Assignment form above.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Create and publish organizational announcements targeted at one or more Communities. Members and Leaders currently eligible for a target see it in their own dashboard once published. Announcements are official one-way notices with read receipts — they do not support comments or reactions. For discussion and engagement, use Headquarters Posts instead.
